title: GrowthCode sync response
description: Response of POST https://ids.api.gcprivacy.id/v4/sync/api?pid=…&u=… (form body gcid, h, ref, maid, maid_type). Produced by GrowthCode; every field is optional and unknown fields are allowed. Never sampled live (POST); fixtures are synthetic.

_synthetic.description: Fixture marker. Present only in hand-made fixtures, never on the wire.

gc_id.description: GrowthCode id to persist and replay. JSON null reads as the text "null" through Android org.json on device.

eb.description: Serialized EID blob: JSON text of an eid-blob array.

idi.description: Whether id injection is on for this response.

cookies.description: Web-only field, ignored by the SDKs.

kv.description: Web-only field, ignored by the SDKs.

dl.description: Web-only field, ignored by the SDKs.

ls.description: Web-only field, ignored by the SDKs.

bucket.description: Web-only field, ignored by the SDKs.

gctest.description: Web-only field, ignored by the SDKs.

persistent.description: Web-only field, ignored by the SDKs.
